title: Velocity-Field Detection of Computation in Forced Navier–Stokes Flows
main_claim: Theorem 1.1: for every computable ν>0, effective smooth forces exist with u(0)=0 and unique smooth solutions with pressure zero. (1) On T^3, sup_t u_3>1/2 somewhere in the strip 1/32<y<1/8 exactly when the machine halts. The force is supported in K×T for a fixed compact K. (2) On R^2×T, the force has globally bounded mixed derivatives, and ∫_{X_2>0} u_3 >1/2 at some time exactly when the machine halts.
